en_US.title: Ascent Repair Certification Bands
en_US.scanner: Escape recipes need bands before numbers: relay, seal, guidance, ascent energy, legal handshake and payload authority.
en_US.field_note: Every escape recipe should ask what physical failure it solves and what deeper route it forces.
en_US.terminal: RECIPE BANDS: emergency patch, rated repair, containment-grade, ascent-qualified, and Atlas-authority. Each band carries count, quality, pressure stage, and certification requirements.
en_US.audio: A recipe is a route, not a shopping list.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Ascent Repair Certification Bands keep crafting tied to survival engineering: emergency patch, rated repair, containment-grade, ascent-qualified, and Atlas-authority hardware.
en_US.external_site: Ascent repair certification separates emergency patchwork from ascent-qualified hardware by pressure stage, certification, and failure consequence.

en_US.title: Inventory Stack Pressure Rule

en_US.audio: If it can break your claim, it should not stack like scrap.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Inventory Stack Pressure Rule keeps salvage weight physical and legible through vessel class, pressure rating, contamination stage, lien mass, certification, and sample quality.
en_US.external_site: Critical resources do not stack like scrap: containment, contamination, pressure, and custody decide what can travel together.
